resources.string: Emergency Destroy
Destroy All
Destroy All
This erases what ZCHAT keeps in its own storage on this phone:
All chat messages and history
Your wallet and private keys
Your payment history
All contacts and nicknames
AI chats and pictures, and the files ZCHAT fetched for your chats
ZCHAT\'s own settings

Before you destroy, wait for any payment to an exchange (TEX) address to finish. Destroy All does not wait for it: an unfinished one leaves its ZEC at a one-time address of this wallet, and ZCHAT cannot bring that ZEC back after Destroy All.
Not erased: pictures, voice notes and files you saved from ZCHAT to this phone (Gallery, Music, Downloads). They are not encrypted. Delete them yourself.

Whoever has your recovery phrase can restore this wallet and its payment history, and may be able to restore messages that were sent on the blockchain. If nobody must ever restore them, destroy every copy of the phrase too.
What Destroy All cannot erase

The blockchain keeps every payment and every message that was sent on it, for good. Shielded ones are encrypted: they can be read with your recovery phrase or with a viewing key you exported, and each message by the people it went to. Transparent payments and their amounts are public.
Your contacts\' phones keep their copy of your chats, your address and the picture you shared. Another phone of yours with the same wallet keeps everything it has.

Relay servers keep encrypted copies of recent Open and Tunnel messages for some time, and public file hosts keep the encrypted photos, files and voice notes that were sent. ZCHAT cannot delete them there. Only someone with the right keys can open them: with your recovery phrase someone may be able to open messages that were sent to you, and the people you wrote to can open what you sent them.

Services ZCHAT talked to may keep their own records: the sync server and ZCHAT\'s call servers (your IP address and the times), the Swap service (your swaps and their addresses) and the AI provider (what you asked the AI).

ZCHAT\'s server keeps this wallet\'s AI account: its credit, its top-up records and a record of each AI request (when, and which model). Restoring this wallet\'s recovery phrase in ZCHAT opens that account again only if ZCHAT had linked it to the phrase before; the screen where you set the Destroy PIN shows whether it has.

If Reset ZCHAT kept a key to AI credit on this phone for another recovery phrase, Destroy All deletes that key too. That credit stays on ZCHAT\'s server; after that, restoring the other phrase on this phone no longer brings its key back.
ZCHAT cannot read this wallet\'s AI data on this phone. If it holds a key to AI credit, Destroy All deletes it.
This phone holds a key to an AI account that may hold paid credit and that your recovery phrase cannot open. Destroy All deletes that key. The AI tab says what can be done first.
This wallet\'s AI account may hold paid credit and may not be linked to your recovery phrase yet. Destroy All deletes this phone\'s key to it, and the phrase may not open it.

Older ZCHAT versions may have put an encrypted copy of your saved contacts and transaction notes into a phone backup (on most phones: Google backup). ZCHAT cannot delete that copy. To remove it, delete the backups of every phone you used ZCHAT on, in your backup account. The copy is encrypted with a key made from your recovery phrase.
On this phone, outside ZCHAT: screenshots, viewing keys you exported, and text that your keyboard or the phone\'s notification history kept. ZCHAT cannot reach them.
What Android keeps for ZCHAT (permissions, language, notification settings) stays until ZCHAT is uninstalled.

Restore this phrase on this phone and the key is there again; on another phone the phrase may not open that account yet. The key stays until Destroy All or an uninstall removes it. To hand this phone on, use Destroy All.

What Destroy All erases

Destroy All erases what ZCHAT keeps in its own storage on this phone (your wallet and its recovery phrase, your payment history, your messages, your contacts, AI chats and pictures, the files ZCHAT fetched for your chats and ZCHAT\'s own settings) and then asks your phone to uninstall ZCHAT. It does not erase pictures and files you saved from ZCHAT to this phone.
Advanced
Destroy everything

(wallet and recovery phrase, payment history, messages, contacts, AI chats and pictures, fetched files, ZCHAT\'s own settings, its notification categories and its background jobs. What stays while ZCHAT is installed: the app itself and your phone\'s own settings for it, with the phone\'s note that notification categories were deleted; an empty job table of Android\'s background-work system; and a small record that ZCHAT removes the next time it starts.)
Keep some things
Names of your chat contacts

When you destroy, ZCHAT first erases the recovery phrase, then copies the names and addresses of your chat contacts into one list that stays on this phone, and then erases everything else, your contacts and nicknames themselves included. Copying takes up to two seconds. If the list is kept, ZCHAT is not uninstalled. Whoever opens ZCHAT on this phone afterwards can see who your contacts were.

You find the list in Advanced Settings → Names you kept. A kept name is only a name: ZCHAT treats its address as if the name were not on the list, until you save it as a contact there. The wallet\'s Contacts list for payments is not kept. If ZCHAT cannot copy the list at that moment, it destroys everything.

Any old wallet data from a different recovery phrase that ZCHAT set aside on this phone to rescan is deleted too; funds of that other wallet are still reached with its own recovery phrase.

Some things stay on this phone: what ZCHAT keeps for other recovery phrases; ZCHAT\'s own record of payments it had to recover or send again, kept so that nothing is paid twice; message counters of this wallet\'s chats (numbers only: no name, no address, no text), kept so that no encryption key is used twice if this recovery phrase comes back; ZCHAT\'s settings that hold nothing of a wallet; any crash reports ZCHAT wrote; and, in a rare case, this wallet\'s saved-contacts or notes file, which can only be read with this recovery phrase.
ZCHAT closes to finish the reset; if it does not open again by itself, open it.
